name: Mahatma Gandhi
title: Father of the Nation
quote: The future depends on what you do today. Gram Swaraj is the true essence of Indian independence.
historicalVision: Empower rural villages as self-sufficient economic units, uphold cleanliness as godliness, and promote local craftsmanship.
modernAlignment: Swachh Bharat Abhiyan, PM-Kisan, Vocal for Local, Khadi India, Rural Digitalization.

name: Dr. B.R. Ambedkar
title: Architect of the Indian Constitution
quote: Educate, Agitate, Organize. Cultivation of mind should be the ultimate aim of human existence.
historicalVision: A casteless, egalitarian society rooted in justice, rule of law, equal opportunities, and constitutional rights.
modernAlignment: Nari Shakti Vandan Adhiniyam, Digital Literacy, Stand-Up India, Samagra Shiksha Abhiyan, Reservation in Governance.

name: Netaji Subhash Chandra Bose
title: Leader of Azad Hind Fauj
quote: Give me blood, and I shall give you freedom! One individual may die for an idea, but that idea will incarnate itself in a thousand lives.
historicalVision: Rapid industrial development, disciplined national service, military self-sufficiency, and unified national spirit.
modernAlignment: Make in India, Defense Indigenization, PM Gati Shakti Infrastructure, National Youth Policy.

name: Shaheed Bhagat Singh
title: Icon of Youth Revolution
quote: They may kill me, but they cannot kill my ideas. They can crush my body, but they will not be able to crush my spirit.
historicalVision: A society free from economic exploitation, led by conscious, educated, and questioning youth fighting for universal welfare.
modernAlignment: Atmanirbhar Bharat Startups, Atal Innovation Mission, Student R&D Grants, Youth Civic Engagement.

name: Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel
title: Iron Man of India
quote: Manpower without unity is not a strength unless it is harmonized and united properly, then it becomes a spiritual power.
historicalVision: A strong, unified India bound by administrative excellence, integrated states, and robust farmer cooperatives.
modernAlignment: Ek Bharat Shreshtha Bharat, Amul/Cooperative Reforms, Civil Services Modernization (Mission Karmayogi), Statue of Unity Complex.

name: Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam
title: People's President & Missile Man
quote: Dream is not that which you see while sleeping, it is something that does not let you sleep. Empowered youth change the world.
historicalVision: Transform India into a Developed Nation (Vision 2020) driven by knowledge, technology, value-based education, and space-age innovation.
modernAlignment: Viksit Bharat @2047, ISRO Gaganyaan & Chandrayaan, National DeepTech Startup Policy, NEP 2020 Skill Labs.

name: Sarojini Naidu
title: Nightingale of India
quote: A new sun has risen above India’s horizon. Women are not merely partners in freedom, but leaders of destiny.
historicalVision: Full equal partnership of women in political leadership, education, and national reform.
modernAlignment: Women-led Development (G20 Focus), Lakhpati Didi Scheme, Self Help Group (SHG) Bank Linkage, Mudra Loans for Female Entrepreneurs.

name: Swami Vivekananda
title: Spiritual Renaissance Leader
quote: Arise, awake, and stop not till the goal is reached. All power is within you; you can do anything and everything.
historicalVision: Regeneration of India through character-building education, uplifting the downtrodden, and global intellectual pride.
modernAlignment: National Youth Day Initiatives, Fit India Movement, Universal Health Care (Ayushman Bharat), Skill India.
